# dsh-quota-pets
**Quota Pets** — a chibi desktop-pet companion for DeepSeek Harness, one mascot per LLM coding plan:
| Pet | Provider | Theme color |

| 🦊 Broad-Eared Fox Girl | GLM (z.ai / bigmodel) | Purple `#8B7CF6` |
| 🎙️ Conch Reporter Girl | Min

iMax | Pink `#FF7DA0` |
| 🎵 Star-Moon Flute Girl | Kimi (Moonshot) | Gold `#F5C445` |
| 🐋 Whale Girl

| DeepSeek | Blue `#4D6BFE` |
| 🧡 Bunny-Hood Girl | Xiaomi MiMo | Orange `#FF6900` |

All five mascots are fully animated (idle / working / done / error / sleeping,
WebP, ≤12 fps, tuned

to fit tight byte budgets — see the asset
contract).

Quota data is consumed entirely from
dsh-quota-hub
(`/dsh-quota-hub/status.json`) — this plugin neve

r touches your API keys.
Without quota-hub installed, the pet still runs (question-mark state).
简体中文说明点这里
## Behavior

**Follows the active model** — only one pet is visible at a time: the one
matching the model of the

current session. Switching models fades the old
pet out and the new one in. A brand-new conversation

shows no pet until the
first query fixes the model (nothing matches → nothing shown).
| State | Behavior |

| Idle | Gentle floating; click to hop + refresh now |
| Session running | Working pose (each pet's
own: whale girl eating, fox girl flipping pages, reporter girl with her clapperboard, flute girl pla

ying, bunny-hood girl with her plush) + glow ⚡ |
| Run finished | One-shot celebration (~3s) ✅, then

back to idle |
| Run errored | Drooping pose, badge ❌ |
| Idle 10 min | Sleeping 💤 (whale curl, gir
l naps on her rabbit…) |

Quota pressure is rendered as an overlay (badge + bubble + filter), never as
art: hover for the wors

t window usage + reset countdown; ≥70% warn / ≥90%
critical coloring; no key or disabled provider →

ghost mode; query failed →
question mark ❓ with the error in the bubble.

Right-click menu: temporary avatar preview / size (64/88/112px) / reset
position / developer state c

ycler. Position and size are shared across all
pets and remembered in localStorage. Full state machi

ne and design reference
in docs/pet-capabilities.md (Chinese).
## Custom avatars

Assets live in `assets/<petId>/<state>.webp` (animated) plus
`<state>-static.webp` or `.png` (static

fallback for reduced-motion), plus
optional transition clips `<from>-to-<to>.webp` played once betw

een states
(GLM opens its book, MiniMax picks up its board or sits down to sleep), hot-swapped
withi

n seconds — naming rules in assets/README.txt,
validation via `scripts/validate-assets.py`, full spe

c in the asset
contract.

## Design credits

All five mascots are chibi renditions of **community anthropomorphic
designs** — none of them is an

official mascot of the respective company.
Reference sources recorded during production:

- **DeepSeek whale girl** — based on the fisharchive.cc
chibi redesign (character redesigns marked C

C BY-NC-SA 4.0 on the site).
- **GLM broad-eared fox girl** — community fox-girl references from
agg

regator galleries and the
ai-chan-sheets project
(character by ZipZipPipe; repo CC BY-NC-SA).
- **Ki

mi star-moon flute girl** — Kimi character by
ZipZipPipe
(asymmetric outfit per the original post).

- **MiniMax conch reporter girl** — MiniMax character by
ZipZipPipe, with
auxiliary structure sheets

from ai-chan-sheets.
- **MiMo bunny-hood girl** — MiMo character by 甶丶 ([submission marked CC
BY-NC

](https://github.com/lmy414/ai-girl-stickers/issues/35); mirrored in
ai-girls).

Where a source does not state a license, we record the reference without
